title: Ortiz2023: Motor imagery during walking with a lower-limb exoskeleton
description: EEG recordings from 10 healthy participants performing kinesthetic motor imagery of gait while walking with a fully assisted lower-limb exoskeleton on flat ground. The paradigm alternates motor imagery with relaxation and a regressive-count distractor task, cued by auditory stimuli. Data were recorded with 27 EEG and 4 EOG channels at 200 Hz as part of the DECODED EUROBENCH subproject, and are re-released in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was acquired with a Brain Products actiCHamp amplifier (27 EEG and 4 EOG channels, 200 Hz, Ag/AgCl wet electrodes, left earlobe reference, right earlobe ground, 0.1 Hz high-pass and 50 Hz notch online filters). Each participant completed one session of 16 runs with 9 s trials of relax, motor imagery, and regressive count conditions, cued by audio.
